decision.reason: [ev-58fe3b69692b] is a single release-note line. It says only that "name table output" contained unready endpoints for headless services and that this was fixed. It names headless services, but it does not say what the name table is, which component or feature produces or uses it, or which settings make an environment depend on that output. Without that, no declarative applicability condition can be written. The linked PR or issue, or documentation for the name table, is needed.
